verdict: ConfigMgr site database upgrade aborted because the site server's .NET Framework is below the minimum. Current branches require 4.6.2 at minimum and recommend 4.8.
fix: On the site server, check the installed .NET version: `(Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\NET Framework Setup\NDP\v4\Full').Release`. 528040 or higher = 4.8; 394802 or higher = 4.6.2. Install `NDP48-x86-x64-AllOS-ENU.exe` from the offline installer, reboot the site server, resume the CM update from `Administration / Updates and Servicing`. Do not attempt to bypass the prereq; a half-upgraded site DB is an incident requiring SQL restore from backup.
